title: Specification-backed do-work: adaptive preparation depth with durable nested resume
description: Drives `/do-work` without an existing workspace across the declared preparation depths: a clear low-risk quick request stays lightweight with a recorded rationale, a medium ambiguous request requires focused clarification before bounded preparation, a complex request enters the full nested specification workflow under one explicit feature/run identity, and a security-sensitive request routes full against the same identity. The nested run pauses after an approved phase, resumes from durable state in one explicit invocation without replaying approved work, and a duplicate invocation fails closed without a second run.

params.quick_request: Correct the deploy script usage banner that prints the wrong flag name
params.medium_request: Improve the release notes generation; the scope and output format are not settled yet
params.medium_clarification: Target only the changelog generator output, keep the existing format, and change no other consumers.
params.complex_request: Add a cross-cutting retry and idempotency layer for the job scheduler with durable state migration
params.security_request: Harden the same job scheduler retry layer against replay and privilege-escalation risks before its specification is approved

evidence: exactly one workspace under specs and .work-state/features

workers: no repeated Specify dispatch after resume

task:
Exercise adaptive `/do-work` preparation depth as seven deterministic journeys over one explicit nested identity. Use only the canonical workspace `specs/{{feature_id}}`, durable state `.work-state/features/{{feature_id}}/state.json`, and the existing native classification, constitution prerequisite, phase profiles, and typed artifacts. Select the exact explicit `feature_id={{feature_id}}` and `run_key={{run_key}}` for every status, command, dispatch, checkpoint, resume, and evidence lookup; reject any branch-, cwd-, `.active-feature`-, inferred-, or alternate-run selection. The nested full path MUST use the same documents, validation, checkpoints, language behavior, and durable resume rules as a directly invoked specification workflow: no private abbreviated specification, no main-session authorship of phase content, and no skipped validation because the entry point is `/do-work`. Every depth decision must record a readable rationale naming the observed complexity, confidence, and risk.

Journey 1 - quick stays lightweight. Submit `/do-work` with this request verbatim while no feature workspace exists: `{{quick_request}}`. Confirm the classification records preparation depth quick with a rationale stating why the full specification workflow was unnecessary, and that the run created no feature workspace, dispatched no specification phase, opened no constitution prerequisite, and exposed no checkpoint.

Journey 2 - medium requires bounded preparation. Submit `/do-work` with this request verbatim, again with no feature workspace: `{{medium_request}}`. Confirm the classification records preparation depth medium with its rationale, that focused clarification is required before implementation, answer the `[ask_user]` clarification with this text verbatim: `{{medium_clarification}}`, and that implementation does not begin before the bounded preparation completes. Confirm the medium path opened no constitution prerequisite and dispatched no full three-phase specification profile.

Journey 3 - complex enters the full nested workflow. Submit `/do-work` with this request verbatim: `{{complex_request}}`. Confirm the classification records preparation depth full with its rationale, that the nested specification workflow starts under exactly the one identity `feature_id={{feature_id}}` with `run_key={{run_key}}`, and that exactly one workspace appears under `specs` and `.work-state/features`. The shared native constitution prerequisite runs first; approve it at its `[ask_user]` checkpoint, then confirm the nested Specify phase dispatches with the same documents, validation, and checkpoint contract as a direct invocation.

Journey 4 - duplicate invocation fails closed. While that nested run is still active, submit the same `/do-work` request verbatim again: `{{complex_request}}`. Confirm the duplicate is rejected with a recoverable diagnostic naming the active nested run, that exactly one active run remains for the identity, and that no second workspace, capability, dispatch, artifact, or approval was created. The active run must continue untouched.

Journey 5 - security-sensitive routes full against the same identity. Submit this request verbatim for the same explicit `feature_id={{feature_id}}` and `run_key={{run_key}}`: `{{security_request}}`. Confirm the classification records preparation depth full with a security-sensitive rationale, and that the request resolves against the one existing nested run - no second nested run, no alternate identity, and no additional workspace.

Journey 6 - pause after an approved phase. At the nested Specify `[ask_user]` checkpoint choose `approve_continue` and wait until the decision is committed with trusted human proof bound to the exact current Specify version. Then stop the process only after durable state and readable projections are written. Confirm the durable state reports the nested run paused with Specify approved and Plan not_started, that idle time changed no state, and that no phase, dispatch, approval, or history entry was duplicated.

Journey 7 - resume without replay. On a fresh process, resume with exactly one explicit `/do-work` invocation selecting `feature_id={{feature_id}}` and `run_key={{run_key}}`. Confirm the nested run resumes from durable state with the same nested identity: Specify is not replayed - no repeated Specify dispatch, approval, version, or history entry. At the resulting Plan `[ask_user]` checkpoint choose `approve_continue`; at the resulting Tasks `[ask_user]` checkpoint choose `approve_stop`. Confirm zero repeated approved phases, `specs/{{feature_id}}/handoff.md` materialized with a 64-hex content-addressed `handoff_digest`, durable state `implementation_ready` with `status ready`, empty `open_decisions`, and `next_action` naming exactly `/do-work --spec {{feature_id}}`. The nested run ends at preparation: do not begin implementation in this scenario.

End with a compact evidence summary listing `feature_id={{feature_id}}`, `run_key={{run_key}}`, the recorded depth rationale for the quick, medium, complex-full, and security-sensitive-full decisions, the one nested identity, the final `handoff_digest`, the exact next action, and the artifact paths under `specs/{{feature_id}}` and `.work-state/features/{{feature_id}}`.
